test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92cb1d694f6ac21127a8ce4f2502ef663969a286813370cbc4d4a0f2c17936be.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The corner elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The two center bottom elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c6deeb7b7aeba22065bad7fedb01f1187a73ac92da29e79ce7f063406538c88.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements shift clockwise in the circle of Z-shape subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e060ae027ee56000f8bb9094f3f28930bf8df205ff3915b301c55b9719f945bb.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c7ef042e5c93ff6cb852636c7f4b147815a5ec45ccdda590f6e3410c6c94ef4.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
